question: Who among the following Buddhist monks came from China to India during the reign of Chandragupta II?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Fa- Hien**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fa-Hien **was a Chinese Buddhist monk and traveler who came to India during the reign of Chandragupta II**
 
• Fa-Hien traveled to India from China in 399 A.D. to study Buddhism and collect Buddhist scriptures.
 
• Fa-Hien **visited India in the early 5th century AD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Chinese Buddhist travelers to India**
 
• **Hiuen Tsang**:
 
 
• A famous **Chinese Buddhist monk who visited India during the reign of King Harshavardhan.**
 
• He studied Buddhism in monasteries such as Kashmir, Sialkot, Kanauj, and Nalanda.
 
• He **wrote a book called Si-yu-ki** (Record of the Western Countries). 
 
 
 
• **I-tsing: **
 
 
• **​**A **Chinese traveller and Buddhist monk who came to India by sea in 675 A.D.**
 
• He stayed at the **Nalanda monastery for ten years**, studying the Vinya
